purpose: Let main-session Veritas decide/recommend exact paper-order terms from capital alerts, then ask Randall for final approval on a fully specified WF67 package without inferring approval or executing automatically.
core_answer: Main session should be allowed to choose and prepare proposed paper-order terms as advice, but final paper execution remains blocked until Randall approves the exact request artifact/order card after dry-run and guard proof.

recommended_workflow.name: capital_alert
recommended_workflow.output: VRT/CME/PH/etc. proposal-ready alert with fresh quote, band, stop, starter/target sizing, blocker, and risk note.

recommended_workflow.name: main_session_order_decision_card
recommended_workflow.output: Main session selects proposed ticker/side/notional-or-qty/order-type/TIF/limit based on sizing/risk rules and writes an approval-ready order card.

recommended_workflow.name: wf67_request_artifact
recommended_workflow.output: Generate exact WF67 paper request artifact from the order card.

recommended_workflow.name: preapproval_dry_run_and_guard
recommended_workflow.output: Run dry run and paper/live isolation guard validation. If guard requires kill switch, expected status is approval_pending_or_kill_switch_missing, not executable.

recommended_workflow.name: randall_final_approval_card
recommended_workflow.output: Ask Randall to approve the exact package: ticker, side, qty/notional, type, TIF, limit if any, max notional/loss, source artifacts, guard status, and kill-switch requirement.

recommended_workflow.name: execution_window_only_after_approval
recommended_workflow.output: After exact approval, create fresh short-lived kill switch, rerun guard validation, then execute through WF67 wrapper only if clean.
recommended_workflow.authority: paper-only execution under WF67; live still blocked

tuesday_application.primary: ETN remains separate primary ready-if-fresh candidate.
tuesday_application.likely_order_card_candidates: VRT/CME/PH if fresh Tuesday quotes remain in band; NVDA only if Randall explicitly accepts Tech-cap exception/substitution; GE needs promotion decision; ITA no-chase until band clears.

implementation_gap: Current wf67_advisor_paper_request_generator.py builds from WF68 advisor packets. To make main session fully capable, add or extend a request generator that accepts a main-session order decision card/capital recommendation artifact directly, then emits the WF67 request artifact for dry-run/guard proof.
acceptance_criteria: Given a proposal-ready candidate, main session can produce an approval card with exact order terms and sizing rationale.
Generator writes WF67 request artifact without contacting Alpaca or creating kill switch.
Dry-run and guard validation can run pre-approval and clearly stop before execution.
Final assistant message asks Randall to approve one exact package, not a vague recommendation.
No live endpoint/account/money path exists; no owner approval inference; no automatic execution.
